scheme_name: Scheme For Award Of Stipend To The Schedule Tribe Students Of Arunachal Pradesh
other_conditions: Students in full‑time employment are not eligible for the stipend
A student who fails a class and is re‑admitted in the same level of study for a different course/stream is not eligible for the stipend for that class
Students against whom disciplinary action is taken are not eligible for the stipend
Students whose attendance is below 75 % in any month (unless for certified health or bereavement reasons) are not eligible for the stipend
Students pursuing their studies through correspondence or distance‑education mode are not eligible for the stipend
Students studying in institutions not recognized by the State or Central regulators such as UGC, AICTE, MCI, DCI, BCI, CCH are not eligible for the stipend
benefits_summary: Provides monthly stipends and annual book grants to eligible Scheduled Tribe students of Arunachal Pradesh pursuing higher, technical, or professional courses.
documents_required: Attested copy of Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe Certificate
Attested copy of Mark sheet of last examination passed
